plan.title: feat(security): migrate eval/doctor/xbrief residual product writes (#2980 wave C)

narratives.Description: Residual #2980 wave C migrates eval ledgers, doctor-state, residual cache fetch, and xbrief/vbrief project IO product writes onto containedWrite. These sinks still appear in the product inventory after Phase 2. Engine-only; leave init-deposit and intake to sibling waves.
narratives.Overview: Eval and identity/migrate residual product sinks.
narratives.UserStory: As a security maintainer, I want eval and xbrief project IO writes on containedWrite, so that ledgers and project definition writers refuse escape.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Migrate packages/core/src/eval/run.ts, crud-telemetry.ts, health.ts, readback.ts product appends/writes. Step 2: Migrate doctor/doctor-state.ts and residual cache/fetch.ts. Step 3: Migrate xbrief-migrate/migrate-project.ts and vbrief-build/project-definition-io.ts product writes. Step 4: Tests + CHANGELOG #2980 wave C. drive-to: merge-ready.

narrative.Acceptance: Given eval health/telemetry/run write paths execute, they call containedWrite and related vitest suites return pass.
When doctor-state and residual cache fetch writers run, they use containedWrite and inventory drops those paths.
When migrate-project and project-definition-io write project JSON, they use containedWrite and tests return pass.
When CHANGELOG.md is opened, it records an Unreleased entry that cites #2980 wave C.

verify_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/eval packages/core/src/doctor packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate packages/core/src/vbrief-build
